caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded jug with a wide body, a narrow neck, and a flared rim, rendered in shades of black, dark green, and grey, with lighter, wavy streaks and highlights to suggest reflections on a glassy surface. The jug has a single, looped handle attached at the top of the neck and upper portion of the body. There are two raised horizontal bands encircling the vessel, one below the rim and another around the midsection. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset drawing showing a close-up view titled "Tip of handle," focusing on the connection of the handle to the jug, done in monochrome. The main and inset images are placed within rectangular borders on a neutral, beige background. The artist's name "John Tarantino" appears in faint, small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Pitcher
